card.name: Mixed positions in reference-style citations
card.fires_on: Words inside formal reference text: the year digit in birth-death dates, 'Drug' in '[see Drug Interactions]', and 'of'/'States'/'Parliament' in official titles.

modes.label: Cross-reference
modes.description: The word Drug right after 'see' in a section cross-reference to Drug Interactions.
modes.example: increase the toxicities of fluorouracil [see<< Drug>> Interactions ( 7 )]

modes.label: Dates in biographies
modes.description: A digit inside a year in a birth-death range in an encyclopedia entry.
modes.example: John Millington Synge Synge, John Millington (sĭng) [key], 187<<1>>–1909, Irish poet

modes.label: Official titles
modes.description: A middle word of a formal institution or publication name.
modes.example: Regulation (EU) No 995/2010 of the European<< Parliament>> and of the Council of 20

card.plain: It fires on the middle of formal names, titles and cross-references, such as 'see Drug Interactions' or a date range.
